CustomField.description: A custom SUMO Admissions Scheduling Link for appointments connecting a specific Admissions Counselor with a specific contact.
CustomField.formula:
/*The SUMO Admissions Scheduling Link for appointments connecting a specific Admissions Counselor with a specific contact.*/
IF( NOT(ISBLANK(OwnerId)), "https://excelsior.my.site.com/s/onlinescheduler?processId=a9n4O000000g0zaQAA" & "&whoId=" & OwnerId & "&clientId=" & Id, "" )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Use this custom link to schedule a SUMO Admissions appointment between the contact owner and the contact.
CustomField.label: SUMO CEP URL Admissions
